best_idea: Store each replay step with the gap to the next step, cap the dead gaps, and drive playback with one speed divide on one clock, so a long idle gap plays short without changing the order of actions.
decision_why: Keep the recorded-gap plus dead-gap-cap shape for Pit replays, but on Frankendom's fixed step: store tick numbers, cap dead gaps in ticks and treat speed as a client-only multiplier; reject the donor's wall-clock setTimeout timing, which also ignores the speed control on the step-to-step timer.
acceptance: A Pit replay of a bout with a 20 s dead gap plays that gap in 5 s at 1x; at 2x the whole replay runs in half the time with the same action order and the same final HP; a server test replays the stored tick list and asserts the same result.
